title: elatostema japonicum var. majus
intro: Elatostema japonicum var. majus, commonly known as the Japanese cinnamon vine or Japanese polynema, is a perennial plant native to East Asia. The plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its health benefits of reducing fever and inflammation, and its therapeutic actions of acting as an anti-inflammatory and antipyretic agent. The bioactive constituents of Elatostema japonicum var. majus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Furthermore, the plant has been found to have antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
